high_level_description: The image depicts two individuals standing close together outdoors on what appears to be a sunny day. The person on the left is wearing a black and white patterned top with thin straps, sunglasses, and a necklace. They have long dark hair and are looking slightly upwards and to the side. The person on the right is shirtless, revealing tattoos on their arms and chest, and is wearing a black cap with yellow text and a necklace with a cross pendant. They also have sunglasses and are looking in the same direction as the other individual.
